TOOLING BURST FL-5b — release sockets by the FERRULE rule (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; conductor F-C5-41 after eyeing FL-5's socket_audit/contact_sheet.png). task_id "FL-5b". Data + tests only; no runtime change expected.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows FL-1a, FL-5 and the new row "FL-5b — release sockets by the ferrule rule" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json, runs/C-3/cells_v7/cast_*/ (the release frames, index 3), runs/C-5/t3/FL-5/socket_audit/ (your previous sheet + method), export/godot_import.py (only the release-socket resolution, to confirm no code change is needed), tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY.

THE FINDING (conductor, on your FL-5 sheet): "farthest along the facing" chooses the WRONG END of the staff in S (the cross sits on the belt/hands — the staff points straight UP and its tip is the glowing top end ≈ (242,121)), SW (the cross is on the BUTT end behind the caster; the tip is the upper-right starred end ≈ (328,133)) and W (the lower end; the tip is the upper end ≈ (227,120)); N, NE, NW, E, SE are right. The staff carries a BRASS FERRULE / cap at the tip end in every frame (a warm bright pixel cluster within ~14 px of that end); the butt is plain wood.

RULE: the release socket = the centre of the staff's ferrule end. Method per cell: find the staff axis (the longest thin dark structure, as before), take its two endpoints, score each end by warm-bright pixel mass (R > 150, R−B > 40 or luminance > 200) within 14 px, choose the higher; where both ends are cold (no ferrule visible) fall back to the end FARTHEST FROM THE HANDS' centroid (skin/glove pixel cluster) — never to the facing rule; write the result for ALL EIGHT cells into sockets_v2.json `cells.cast_<dir>.sockets[release_index]` with `release_socket_rule: "ferrule end (FL-5b)"`, and produce socket_audit_v2/contact_sheet.png (each release frame with the OLD socket as a red cross and the NEW as a green cross, plus the ferrule score at each end). Acceptance: S/SW/W within 10 px of the conductor's eye estimates above; the other five within 6 px of their FL-5 values; the eight-direction release clause (FL-1a: (release − origin)·facing > 0, head not inside the body rect) still holds by trace; kits and runtime byte-identical; the socket-audit test (FL-5) realigned to the ferrule rule; catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/ (read only), any kit, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-5b/ and runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json (named entries); fixtures/ only for a byte lock the sockets change re-opens (FL-1b diff rule). No Godot GUI. No deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-5b/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-5b"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
